title: NANO: Unifying Missingness and Input Uncertainty in Tabular Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.29214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Missing values are common in tabular data, yet current approaches to handling them often overlook two dimensions. First, an observed value may be uncertain, while a Not-Observed (N.O.) value may still have a reasonable estimate. Inputs should therefore span a continuous spectrum from no evidence to a fully trusted observation. Second, Not-Applicable (N.A.) means that no meaningful value exists for a record, yet this semantic state often lacks explicit representation. To address both dimensions, we introduce NANO, a unified plug-in for input encoding that fits most token-based architectures. Guided by Bayesian evidence weighting, NANO adjusts the influence of a supplied value according to confidence, with all zero-confidence estimates mapped to the same N.O. representation. translated_title: NANO：统一表格学习中的缺失与输入不确定性
translated_abstract: 缺失值在表格数据中十分常见，然而目前处理缺失值的方法往往忽视了两个维度。第一，已观测到的值可能存在不确定性，而未观测（Not-Observed, N.O.）的值仍可能存在合理的估计。因此，输入应当涵盖一个从“无证据”到“完全可信观测”的连续谱。第二，不适用（Not-Applicable, N.A.）表示某条记录不存在有意义的值，但这种语义状态通常缺乏显式的表示。为了解决这两个维度的问题，我们提出了NANO——一个适用于大多数基于token架构的统一输入编码插件。在贝叶斯证据加权的指导下，NANO根据置信度调整所提供值的影响力，并将所有零置信度的估计映射到同一个N.O.表示上。在训练或推理阶段，NANO可以接受（但不要求）每个样本的置信度信息。对于N.A.，一个独立的表示使模型能够对不适用状态进行编码（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出NANO统一输入编码插件，借助贝叶斯证据加权将输入从“无证据”到“完全可信观测”建模为连续置信度谱，并同时为“未观测（N.O.）”与“不适用（N.A.）”提供显式表示，可适配大多数基于token的表格学习架构。
en_tdlr: NANO is a unified input-encoding plug-in for token-based tabular learning that uses Bayesian evidence weighting to place inputs on a continuum from no evidence to fully trusted observations, while explicitly distinguishing Not-Observed (N.O.) values from Not-Applicable (N.A.) semantics.
